criteria.no: At least one statement can hold while the other does not.
criteria.yes: Each statement entails the other constraint.

same_constraint.instructions: Considering only a.statement and b.statement, do the two constraints mutually entail each other? Ignore wording and quote overlap.

a.statement: The API client must retry HTTP 503 responses twice.

b.statement: On HTTP 503, the API client must make two retry attempts.
